prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire in Three Moves
plan.description: A quick guide to changing a flat tire safely. Learn the key steps: park safe, loosen and lift, then swap the wheel.

beats.narration: A flat tire can strand you anywhere. Good news: you can fix it in minutes. First, park on flat, solid ground and stay safe.
Loosen the lug nuts slightly, then lift the car with the jack. Remove the nuts and pull the flat wheel off.
Mount the spare, tighten the nuts by hand, lower the car, then tighten them fully. Remember to get the flat checked.

props.text: Spare on, nuts tight, flat repaired.
